name: nevnoc
description: Nevnoc — Global web solutions. Website and portfolio (React + Vite + Tailwind, Express + PostgreSQL).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,blue "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.deploy:build: npm ci --include=dev --prefix client && npm ci --prefix server && npm run build
